title: Port of Beaumont post Hurricane Harvey
description:
Hurricane Harvey in 2017 damaged Port of Beaumont infrastructure, eroded shorelines and made the waterway unpassable for some ships.
Working with FEMA, the international shipping hub quickly re-opened and continues to restore and improve facilities.
keywords: FEMA, Beaumont, Region 6, Hurricane Harvey, DR-4332, Texas
